rows.historical_evidence: The frozen v1.28-classic-capability-ledger.md routes Classic patrol documentation accuracy to PROOF-03. 205-04-SUMMARY.md records the real sealReviewRequiredCastes derivation across production, maintenance and discovery projects, the corrected conditional review-team claim, and the seal/entomb card-relay instructions mirrored from the command sources. The named tests in cmd/seal_wrapper_accuracy_test.go were each executed independently by 205-11. This signs the checked documentation claims and source parity; owner-visible card delivery in a live session remains a Journey 1 acceptance check, as 205-04 explicitly records.

The frozen v1.28-classic-capability-ledger.md replaces Classic verify-castes proxy/model guidance with the versioned platform capability contract and truthful readiness reporting under PROOF-04. 205-10-SUMMARY.md and the three 205-PLATFORM-CARD files bind their claims to evidence/platform-runs captures; the named tests in cmd/platform_honesty_card_test.go were each executed independently by 205-11. The captures exercise status entry points: Claude Code and Codex reached the program, while OpenCode stopped at a provider connection error. They do not establish worker dispatch, named-helper routing or complete lifecycle parity; the versioned contract and the cards retain those limits, without promising later work or calling untracked platform behavior program-governed.
